record.paper_title: Some Open Problems and Conjectures on Submanifolds of Finite Type: Recent Development
record.original_question: Are the only finite-type surfaces in E³ the minimal surfaces together with open portions of spheres and circular cylinders, where finite type means that the position vector field has a finite decomposition into Laplace eigenmaps?

evidence.quote: The immersion x is said to be of finite type if the position vector field of M in E^m... can be expressed as a finite sum of E^m-valued eigenfunctions of the Laplace operator.
Conjecture 1.A. The only surfaces of finite type in E^3 are minimal surfaces, and open portions of spheres and circular cylinders.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $x: M \to \mathbb{E}^3$ be an isometric immersion of a smooth surface $M$ into Euclidean 3-space, and let $\Delta$ denote the Laplace operator of the induced metric on $M$ acting componentwise on $\mathbb{E}^3$-valued functions. The immersion $x$ is said to be of finite type if the position vector field admits a finite decomposition
$$x = x_0 + x_1 + x_2 + \cdots + x_k,$$
where $x_0$ is a constant vector in $\mathbb{E}^3$ and each $x_i$ ($1 \le i \le k$) is a non-constant $\mathbb{E}^3$-valued map satisfying $\Delta x_i = \lambda_i x_i$ for some real number $\lambda_i$.

Prove or disprove: the only surfaces of finite type in $\mathbb{E}^3$ are the minimal surfaces together with open portions of round spheres and open portions of circular cylinders.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that the only finite-type surfaces in Euclidean 3-space are minimal surfaces and open portions of spheres and circular cylinders remains a long-standing open problem. Partial results characterize specific classes (tubes, ruled surfaces, quadrics, spiral surfaces, surfaces of revolution) but a general resolution has not appeared. Recent works (e.g., Stamatakis–Al-Zoubi 2015, Al-Zoubi 2022) still treat the conjecture as open and continue to verify it in special cases.

status_evidence.title: On Surfaces of finite Chen-type
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the conjecture and verifies it within particular classes of surfaces in E^3.
status_evidence.claim: Treats the conjecture as still open and provides partial verifications.

status_evidence.title: On surfaces of finite type in Euclidean 3-space (Kodai Math. J.)
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes partial results on finite type surfaces in E^3 within restricted classes.
status_evidence.claim: Partial-results paper supporting that the general conjecture is not settled.

status_evidence.title: Some properties of surfaces of finite III-type
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2022) paper continuing investigation of finite-type surfaces in E^3.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the conjecture is still being investigated in recent literature.
